Eelektross

Electric

Unova · Generation 5

Eelektross is an Electric-type EleFish Pokémon first found in Unova (Generation 5). It stands 2.1 m tall and weighs 80.5 kg. It evolves from Eelektrik. Its highest base stat is Attack (115), with a base stat total of 515.
